contextual_adaptation.reasoning: The educational and conversational intent of the original is effectively preserved. information_completeness.reasoning: All core scientific points, experimental references (double-slit, NSOM, Abbe limit), mathematical relationships (psi², E² proportionality), and logical transitions are fully retained. evaluation.overall_comment:
The translation is a competent, scientifically accurate rendering of the English podcast script into Urdu. It maintains the conversational pacing, successfully conveys complex quantum and optical concepts, and preserves the philosophical tone of the conclusion. Its main limitation lies in the heavy reliance on transliterated technical terms rather than standardized Urdu physics vocabulary, which slightly affects native fluency and terminological elegance.
